_meta.note: Wiki-harvested seed shard. Which rings may be worn twice, read as a BLOCKLIST: a ring is duplicable unless it is Exclusive or a Minor Artifact. This inverts the duplicable_rings.json allowlist it is intended to replace (#566). Coverage is total over the ring population, so no ring falls through to a fail-closed default here — but the consuming code must still refuse any Ring absent from `harvested`.
_meta.source: ddowiki maintained categories, computed by Template:Bind and the Minor Artifact categories: Category:Exclusive, Category:Finger items, Category:{1,3,4,5} Slot Minor Artifacts
_meta.mechanic: Exclusive: 'A character is only allowed to have a single version of an Exclusive item in their inventory.' Minor Artifact: 'A character may only equip a single Minor Artifact, regardless of slot.'
_meta.population: All 435 pages in Category:Finger items were read. 435/435 carry the Named-item infobox and an affirmative `bind` parameter; 0 pages missing, 0 with an empty bind. This is what licenses reading category-absence as a stated negative rather than as silence — see the evidence doc.
_meta.warning: Do NOT re-derive these values by text-matching the bind wikitext. Template:Bind accepts the exclusive flag as a bare positional argument, so only 2 of the 45 Exclusive rings spell the word: a text-match finds 2 and misses 43. The template-computed category is the only correct read.
_meta.consumed_by: src/ring_exclusivity.py, via build_dataset.py - stamps `duplicable_ring` per item
